sessionInterchange.importTitle: Import a Claude Code or Codex session
sessionInterchange.importDescription: Creates a new narrator from an existing session. Subagents are imported with it. The original files are not changed.
sessionInterchange.uploadHint: Select the session .jsonl (Codex: .jsonl or .jsonl.zst). For Claude Code, also add the agent-*.jsonl files from the session's subagents folder to keep its subagents; they live in a different folder, so use “Add files” again to append them. The format is detected automatically.
